articles.title: Hindustan Composites Appoints Vinay Sarin as CEO, Approves Q2 FY27 Results
articles.description: Hindustan Composites Ltd announced the approval of its un-audited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. The Board also appointed Mr. Vinay Sarin as Chief Executive Officer and Key Managerial Personnel (CEO & KMP) effective November 6, 2026. Concurrently, Mr. Sarin resigned as a Non-Executive Non-Independent Director. The company further recommended Mr. Sarin's appointment as Whole-Time Director, designated as Executive Director and CEO, for a three-year term starting December 21, 2026, subject to shareholder approval via postal ballot. Mr. Sarin has also been authorized to determine the materiality of events and make disclosures to stock exchanges.
